en.text: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

zhSimplified.text: 当耶和华救大卫脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗，

zhTraditional.text: 當耶和華救大衛脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩，

en.text: and he said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

zhSimplified.text: 说： 耶和华是我的岩石， 我的山寨，我的救主，

zhTraditional.text: 說： 耶和華是我的巖石， 我的山寨，我的救主，

en.text: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角， 是我的高台，是我的避难所。 我的救主啊，你是救我脱离强暴的。

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角， 是我的高臺，是我的避難所。 我的救主啊，你是救我脫離強暴的。

en.text: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华， 这样，我必从仇敌手中被救出来。

zhTraditional.text: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華， 這樣，我必從仇敵手中被救出來。

en.text: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

zhSimplified.text: 曾有死亡的波浪环绕我， 匪类的急流使我惊惧，

zhTraditional.text: 曾有死亡的波浪環繞我， 匪類的急流使我驚懼，

en.text: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

footnotes.text: 22:6 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 阴间的绳索缠绕我， 死亡的网罗临到我。

zhTraditional.text: 陰間的繩索纏繞我， 死亡的網羅臨到我。

en.text: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

zhSimplified.text: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 向我的 神呼求。 他从殿中听了我的声音； 我的呼求入了他的耳中。

zhTraditional.text: 我在急難中求告耶和華， 向我的上帝呼求。 他從殿中聽了我的聲音； 我的呼求入了他的耳中。

en.text: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

zhSimplified.text: 那时因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖； 天的根基也震动摇撼。

zhTraditional.text: 那時因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖； 天的根基也震動搖撼。

en.text: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

zhSimplified.text: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾； 从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也着了。

zhTraditional.text: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰； 從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也着了。

en.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

zhSimplified.text: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临； 有黑云在他脚下。

zhTraditional.text: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨； 有黑雲在他腳下。

en.text: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

zhSimplified.text: 他坐着基路伯飞行， 在风的翅膀上显现。

zhTraditional.text: 他坐着基路伯飛行， 在風的翅膀上顯現。

en.text: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

zhSimplified.text: 他以黑暗和聚集的水、 天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。

zhTraditional.text: 他以黑暗和聚集的水、 天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。

en.text: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

zhSimplified.text: 因他面前的光辉炭都着了。

zhTraditional.text: 因他面前的光輝炭都着了。

en.text: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华从天上打雷； 至高者发出声音。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華從天上打雷； 至高者發出聲音。

en.text: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.

zhSimplified.text: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散， 发出闪电，使他们扰乱。

zhTraditional.text: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散， 發出閃電，使他們擾亂。

en.text: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的斥责一发，鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现，大地的根基也显露。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的斥責一發，鼻孔的氣一出， 海底就出現，大地的根基也顯露。

en.text: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.

zhSimplified.text: 他从高天伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。

zhTraditional.text: 他從高天伸手抓住我， 把我從大水中拉上來。

en.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

zhSimplified.text: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。

zhTraditional.text: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人， 因為他們比我強盛。

en.text: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

zhSimplified.text: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的倚靠。

zhTraditional.text: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我； 但耶和華是我的倚靠。

en.text: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

zhSimplified.text: 他又领我到宽阔之处； 他救拔我，因他喜悦我。

zhTraditional.text: 他又領我到寬闊之處； 他救拔我，因他喜悅我。

en.text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我， 按着我手中的清潔賞賜我。

en.text: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道， 未曾作惡離開我的上帝。

en.text: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

zhSimplified.text: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例，我也未曾离弃。

zhTraditional.text: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例，我也未曾離棄。

en.text: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。

zhTraditional.text: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。

en.text: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

zhSimplified.text: 所以耶和华按我的公义， 按我在他眼前的清洁赏赐我。

zhTraditional.text: 所以耶和華按我的公義， 按我在他眼前的清潔賞賜我。

en.text: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.

zhSimplified.text: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他；

zhTraditional.text: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他；

en.text: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

zhSimplified.text: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他； 乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。

zhTraditional.text: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他； 乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。

en.text: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

zhSimplified.text: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 但你的眼目察看高傲的人，使他降卑。

zhTraditional.text: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 但你的眼目察看高傲的人，使他降卑。

en.text: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你是我的灯； 耶和华必照明我的黑暗。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你是我的燈； 耶和華必照明我的黑暗。

en.text: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

zhSimplified.text: 我借着你冲入敌军， 借着我的 神跳过墙垣。

zhTraditional.text: 我藉着你衝入敵軍， 藉着我的上帝跳過牆垣。

en.text: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

zhSimplified.text: 至于 神，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。

zhTraditional.text: 至於上帝，他的道是完全的； 耶和華的話是煉淨的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。

en.text: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?

zhSimplified.text: 除了耶和华，谁是 神呢？ 除了我们的 神，谁是磐石呢？

zhTraditional.text: 除了耶和華，誰是上帝呢？ 除了我們的上帝，誰是磐石呢？

en.text: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

zhSimplified.text: 神是我坚固的保障； 他引导完全人行他的路。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝是我堅固的保障； 他引導完全人行他的路。

en.text: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.

zhSimplified.text: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄， 又使我在高处安稳。

zhTraditional.text: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的蹄， 又使我在高處安穩。

en.text: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 他教导我的手能以争战， 甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。

zhTraditional.text: 他教導我的手能以爭戰， 甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。

en.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.

zhSimplified.text: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌； 你的温和使我为大。

zhTraditional.text: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌； 你的溫和使我為大。

en.text: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔； 我的脚未曾滑跌。

zhTraditional.text: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊； 我的腳未曾滑跌。

en.text: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

zhSimplified.text: 我追赶我的仇敌，灭绝了他们， 未灭以先，我没有归回。

zhTraditional.text: 我追趕我的仇敵，滅絕了他們， 未滅以先，我沒有歸回。

en.text: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.

zhSimplified.text: 我灭绝了他们， 打伤了他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。

zhTraditional.text: 我滅絕了他們， 打傷了他們，使他們不能起來； 他們都倒在我的腳下。

en.text: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

zhSimplified.text: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战； 你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。

zhTraditional.text: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰； 你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。

en.text: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

zhSimplified.text: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。

zhTraditional.text: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。

en.text: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们仰望，却无人拯救； 就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。

zhTraditional.text: 他們仰望，卻無人拯救； 就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。

en.text: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

zhSimplified.text: 我捣碎他们，如同地上的灰尘， 践踏他们，四散在地，如同街上的泥土。

zhTraditional.text: 我搗碎他們，如同地上的灰塵， 踐踏他們，四散在地，如同街上的泥土。

en.text: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

zhSimplified.text: 你救我脱离我百姓的争竞， 保护我作列国的元首； 我素不认识的民必事奉我。

zhTraditional.text: 你救我脫離我百姓的爭競， 保護我作列國的元首； 我素不認識的民必事奉我。

en.text: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.

zhSimplified.text: 外邦人要投降我， 一听见我的名声就必顺从我。

zhTraditional.text: 外邦人要投降我， 一聽見我的名聲就必順從我。

en.text: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.

zhSimplified.text: 外邦人要衰残， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。

zhTraditional.text: 外邦人要衰殘， 戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。

en.text: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是活神，愿我的磐石被人称颂！ 愿 神—那拯救我的磐石被人尊崇！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是活神，願我的磐石被人稱頌！ 願上帝－那拯救我的磐石被人尊崇！

en.text: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,

zhSimplified.text: 这位 神就是那为我伸冤、 使众民服在我以下的。

zhTraditional.text: 這位上帝就是那為我伸冤、 使眾民服在我以下的。

en.text: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

zhSimplified.text: 你救我脱离仇敌， 又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的； 你救我脱离强暴的人。

zhTraditional.text: 你救我脫離仇敵， 又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的； 你救我脫離強暴的人。

en.text: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你， 歌颂你的名。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你， 歌頌你的名。

en.text: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 施慈爱给他的受膏者， 就是给大卫和他的后裔， 直到永远！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他所立的王， 施慈愛給他的受膏者， 就是給大衛和他的後裔， 直到永遠！
